questions.question: You are waiting to turn left at a multilane intersection. Opposing traffic is blocking your view. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up quickly when the first lane is clear.
Wait until you can see all lanes are clear before turning.
Wait for an oncoming driver to wave you across.
Move into each lane of traffic as it clears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all lanes are clear before turning.
questions.explanation: Never start a left turn until you can see that all the lanes you need to cross are clear and you can turn safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the curve is to the left. You may see several of these signs along a curve.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear. Also use the proper turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: Smoking or preparing to smoke while driving:
questions.explanation: Smoking while driving is distracting. It causes you to take your hands off the wheel or your eyes off the road.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down gradually.
Turn on hazard lights and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down gradually.
questions.explanation: Do not brake immediately if your tire blows out. Grip the steering wheel firmly to stay in your lane. Release the gas pedal slowly to reduce speed. When you are going very slowly, apply the brakes lightly and pull safely off the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: Two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time from different roads. Which vehicle must yield?
questions.explanation: At any intersection, if two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield the right-of-way to the driver on the right.

questions.question: Two solid white lines mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Vehicles have the right-of-way over pedestrians in crosswalks.
Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of all traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show pedestrians the safe place to cross. You must always stop for pedestrians who are in a crosswalk.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a tiny amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. You cannot drink and drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn you to be careful. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: A speed restriction sign:

options.text: May be ignored in rainy, snowy, or icy conditions.
Shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Curve and turn warning signs have speed signs attached that show a safe speed for those curves and turns. You may feel safe going faster in good weather, but never do this in rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: If one of your tires blows out as you are driving, you should:

options.text: Try to steer straight while gradually slowing by removing your foot from the gas pedal.
Maintain your current speed and steer straight.
Swerve back and forth to alert traffic behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Try to steer straight while gradually slowing by removing your foot from the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, grip the steering wheel tightly and keep the car straight. Ease off the gas pedal. Do not brake until you have control. Once you are in control, brake gently and pull off the road at a safe place.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They warn you about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, a right turn is not allowed.

questions.question: If you become stranded in a snowstorm, the best thing to do is to:

options.text: Get out of the car and go for help.
Lay down in your car and go to sleep.
Walk into the road and get the attention of other drivers.
Stay in the car, as you are most likely to be found when you stay in your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the car, as you are most likely to be found when you stay in your vehicle.
questions.explanation: If you are stranded in a snowstorm, stay in your car and wait for help. You are more likely to be found if you stay in your vehicle. It is also unsafe to walk around in a snowstorm.

questions.question: When approaching a flashing red traffic light, drivers should:

options.text: Drive through the intersection if there is no crossing traffic.
Continue driving, as they have the right-of-way.
Stop if a police officer is nearby.
Treat the light like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the light like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights warn of dangerous intersections. Treat them like stop signs.

questions.question: At dusk or on overcast days, you should:

options.text: Not turn on any vehicle lights.

questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights at dusk or on overcast days. Use low beams when an approaching vehicle is within 1,000 feet or a vehicle ahead is within 500 feet. Always use low beams in bad weather.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.explanation: Stop signs are octagon shaped. This eight-sided shape is used only for stop signs. It tells drivers to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating before or while drinking slows alcohol absorption, but it cannot prevent intoxication if you drink too much.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn drivers about special situations or hazards ahead.

questions.question: A good defensive driver:

options.text: Watches what other drivers are doing

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers are doing
questions.explanation: Even experienced drivers can be distracted. A defensive driver watches other drivers and expects potential problems.

questions.question: You see flashing signals at a railroad crossing. You should:

options.text: Stop and look for a train
Slow down and look for a train
Look for a train, then speed up
Do what the vehicle ahead of you does

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and look for a train
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing signal at a railroad crossing, you must stop at least 15 feet from the nearest rail. Watch for other warning signs like lowered gates or the sound of an approaching train.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear next.

questions.question: When driving on slick roads, you should:
questions.explanation: Driving too fast on slippery roads is dangerous, especially in turns and curves. Approach turns much slower on slippery roads than you normally would.

questions.question: You must pull over for an emergency vehicle:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from
Only if it is following you
Only if it is coming toward you

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from
questions.explanation: You must pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is coming from behind or from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: A transit bus is signaling to re-enter the main road after a stop. You must:

options.text: Honk to let them know you're there

questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus signaling to return to the main road after stopping. Change lanes, slow down, or stop to let the bus safely re-enter traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that a winding road is ahead and they should slow down.
